title: Doctor Who
description: 50 questions about Doctor Who since 2005, from the Ninth Doctor onwards. Each game asks you 10.

questions.text: Which actor played the Ninth Doctor when Doctor Who came back in 2005?
questions.explanation: Christopher Eccleston played the Ninth Doctor in the first series of the new Doctor Who, in 2005.

questions.text: Who played the Tenth Doctor?
questions.explanation: David Tennant was the Tenth Doctor from 2005 to 2010. He came back in 2023 as the Fourteenth Doctor.

questions.text: Who played the Eleventh Doctor?
questions.explanation: Matt Smith played the Eleventh Doctor from 2010 to 2013.

questions.text: Who played the Twelfth Doctor?
questions.explanation: Peter Capaldi played the Twelfth Doctor from 2014 to 2017.

questions.text: In 2017 it was announced that a woman would play the Doctor as the star of the show for the first time. Who was it?
questions.explanation: Jodie Whittaker became the Thirteenth Doctor, the first woman to play the Doctor as the main star.

questions.text: Who played the Fifteenth Doctor?
questions.explanation: Ncuti Gatwa first appeared as the Fifteenth Doctor at the end of 'The Giggle' in 2023.

questions.text: What does TARDIS stand for?
questions.explanation: The TARDIS is the Doctor's time machine and spaceship. It is bigger on the inside.

options.text: Time And Relative Dimension In Space
Travel And Rapid Dimension In Space
Time And Rocket Dimension In Space
Transport And Relative Door In Space

questions.text: Why does the TARDIS look like an old blue police box?
questions.explanation: The chameleon circuit should let the TARDIS disguise itself, but it is broken, so it stays a police box.

options.text: Its chameleon circuit is broken, so it is stuck in that shape
It was built by the police

questions.text: How many hearts does the Doctor have?
questions.explanation: Time Lords like the Doctor have two hearts.

questions.text: What do the Daleks shout when they attack?
questions.explanation: 'Exterminate!' is the Daleks' famous battle cry.

questions.text: What was the name of the very first episode of the new Doctor Who, shown on BBC One in 2005?
questions.explanation: 'Rose' was first shown on 26 March 2005.

questions.text: Who played Rose Tyler, who travels with the Ninth Doctor?
questions.explanation: Billie Piper played Rose Tyler. Rose travelled with the Ninth Doctor and then the Tenth.

questions.text: In 'Rose', plastic monsters called Autons attack London. What famous London landmark was their boss using as a transmitter?
questions.explanation: The Nestene Consciousness controls the Autons and was using the London Eye as a transmitter.

questions.text: In the episode 'Dalek' (2005), where is the lone Dalek being kept?
questions.explanation: A billionaire called Henry Van Statten kept it in his museum of alien objects.

options.text: In a secret underground museum in Utah
At the bottom of the River Thames

questions.text: The Doctor believed the Daleks had all been destroyed in a huge war. What was it called?
questions.explanation: Seeing a Dalek in 'Dalek' shocks the Doctor, because he thought the Last Great Time War had destroyed them.

questions.text: In 'The Empty Child', a child in a gas mask keeps asking which question?
questions.explanation: The story is set in London in 1941, during the Blitz.

questions.text: Captain Jack Harkness, played by John Barrowman, first appears in 'The Empty Child'. Which spin-off series did he later star in?
questions.explanation: Torchwood was a spin-off series, and Captain Jack was its main character.

questions.text: In 'Bad Wolf', the Doctor, Rose and Jack are secretly taken onto Satellite Five. What does it broadcast?
questions.explanation: The Daleks are secretly behind the game shows.

questions.text: At the end of series 1, Rose opens the TARDIS console and takes in the power of what?
questions.explanation: She uses that power to destroy the Daleks, and spreads the words 'Bad Wolf' across time and space.

questions.text: Just before the Ninth Doctor regenerates, what does he tell Rose she was?
questions.explanation: 'You were fantastic. Absolutely fantastic.' Then he turns into the Tenth Doctor.

questions.text: What does the Tenth Doctor's catchphrase 'Allons-y!' mean?
questions.explanation: It is French for 'Let's go!'. You can hear it in 'Army of Ghosts'.

questions.text: In 'School Reunion', the Doctor meets Sarah Jane Smith again, who has an old robot dog. What is it called?
questions.explanation: K-9 destroys himself to save the day, but the Doctor gives Sarah Jane a brand-new K-9 at the end.

questions.text: In 'The Girl in the Fireplace', the Doctor meets a girl called Reinette. Which famous French lady does she grow up to be?
questions.explanation: The Doctor sees her life through 'time windows', starting when she is seven years old.

questions.text: In 'Doomsday' (2006), a small group of Daleks escapes. What are they called?
questions.explanation: The Cult of Skaro escape at the end of 'Doomsday'.

questions.text: In 'Doomsday', Cybermen invade London. Where did they come from?
questions.explanation: They came from a parallel universe. It is also where Rose ends up, stuck, at the end of the story.

questions.text: At the end of 'Planet of the Ood' (2008), what do the freed Ood do?
questions.explanation: Once the Ood are free, they sing together using their telepathy.

options.text: They fly away in a spaceship
They build a statue of the Doctor

questions.text: In 'Smith and Jones' (2007), the Royal Hope Hospital is taken somewhere very strange. Where?
questions.explanation: Martha Jones, played by Freema Agyeman, joins the Doctor after this adventure.

questions.text: When she meets the Doctor, what is Martha Jones studying to become?
questions.explanation: Martha is a medical student.

questions.text: Who wrote 'Blink' (2007), the scary episode with the Weeping Angels?
questions.explanation: The Weeping Angels only move when nobody is looking, which is why the story's warning is 'Don't blink!'

questions.text: Which actor played the Master, the main villain of series 3 in 2007?
questions.explanation: John Simm played the Master from 2007 to 2010.

questions.text: How does Donna Noble first appear in the TARDIS?
questions.explanation: Donna, played by Catherine Tate, appears at the end of 'Doomsday'. Then she is 'The Runaway Bride' in the Christmas special.

questions.text: In 'The Fires of Pompeii' (2008), Peter Capaldi plays a character before he became the Twelfth Doctor. Which one?
questions.explanation: Karen Gillan was in the same episode as a soothsayer, before she played Amy Pond.

questions.text: What famous word does River Song use to mean 'I can't tell you what happens next'?
questions.explanation: River Song, played by Alex Kingston, first appeared in 'Silence in the Library' in 2008.

questions.text: What are the Tenth Doctor's last words before he regenerates in 'The End of Time'?
questions.explanation: He regenerates into the Eleventh Doctor, played by Matt Smith.

questions.text: In 2010, which Doctor said 'Bow ties are cool' in his very first episode?
questions.explanation: Matt Smith's Doctor says it in his first episode, 'The Eleventh Hour' (2010).

questions.text: In 'The Eleventh Hour', the new Doctor meets young Amelia Pond in which English village?
questions.explanation: Years later, Amelia has grown up into Amy Pond, played by Karen Gillan.

questions.text: In 'Vincent and the Doctor', the Doctor and Amy meet which famous painter?
questions.explanation: The story was written by Richard Curtis.

questions.text: In 'The Doctor's Wife' (2011), who turns out to be the Doctor's 'wife'?
questions.explanation: The TARDIS appears as a woman called Idris, played by Suranne Jones. The story was written by Neil Gaiman.

options.text: The TARDIS, in a human body

questions.text: In 'The Angels Take Manhattan', which monsters trap Amy and Rory in New York in the 1930s?
questions.explanation: It is the last story for Amy and Rory.

questions.text: Who played the War Doctor in the 50th anniversary special 'The Day of the Doctor' (2013)?
questions.explanation: It was shown at the same time in many countries in November 2013, with David Tennant and Matt Smith too.

questions.text: In 'The Day of the Doctor', the War Doctor uses a weapon from the Time War. What is it called?
questions.explanation: In the story, the Moment takes the form of a woman played by Billie Piper.

questions.text: In 'The Time of the Doctor' (2013), on which planet does the Eleventh Doctor spend hundreds of years defending against aliens?
questions.explanation: Clara persuades the Time Lords to give him new regenerations, and he becomes the Twelfth Doctor.

questions.text: What nickname does the Doctor give Clara Oswald, played by Jenna Coleman?
questions.explanation: Clara travelled with the Eleventh Doctor and then the Twelfth.

questions.text: What does the female version of the Master call herself?
questions.explanation: Missy was played by Michelle Gomez, the first woman to play the Master.

questions.text: In 'World Enough and Time', what happens to Bill Potts, played by Pearl Mackie?
questions.explanation: Bill is the Twelfth Doctor's companion. She comes back in 'Twice Upon a Time'.

options.text: She is turned into a Cyberman
She turns into a Weeping Angel
She flies away in a rocket

questions.text: In 'Spyfall' (2020), a friendly spy boss called 'O' turns out to be the Master. Which spy agency does he seem to work for?
questions.explanation: Sacha Dhawan, who plays him, is the youngest actor to play the Master.

questions.text: Graham, Ryan and Yaz travel with the Thirteenth Doctor. Which English city do they come from?
questions.explanation: The Thirteenth Doctor's first story, 'The Woman Who Fell to Earth', takes place in Sheffield.

questions.text: What do the Thirteenth Doctor and her friends call their team?
questions.explanation: They take the name after Graham, Ryan and Yaz choose to keep travelling with the Doctor.

questions.text: In 'Fugitive of the Judoon' (2020), a woman called Ruth Clayton is revealed to be what?
questions.explanation: She is the Fugitive Doctor, played by Jo Martin, the first Black actor to play the Doctor in the main show.

options.text: A previously unseen version of the Doctor

questions.text: In 'The Giggle' (2023), the Toymaker is played by which actor?
questions.explanation: 'The Giggle' ends the three 60th anniversary specials with David Tennant and Catherine Tate. Tennant then regenerates into Ncuti Gatwa.
